Synopsis:
    Gambia's police chief banned protests without permits following civil unrest triggered by prolonged power cuts during peak summer heat. The national utility NAWEC is struggling with surging electricity demand. President Barrow has promised new generation capacity (24 MW addition, 50 MW solar contract) and power restoration by end of October. Political tensions are rising ahead of December elections, with critics faulting the government's reliance on energy imports.
